article.title: Reducción para → pra
article.part: Portugués brasileño real y variación — Português brasileiro real e variação
article.chapter: Variación fonológica brasileña — Variação fonológica brasileira

claims.summary: The reduction 'para → pra' is a very common phenomenon in Brazilian Portuguese spoken language. The reduced form emerges from normal processes of rapid speech and appears widely in informal registers.

The reduction affects the sound chain of the preposition and can be written in texts representing orality: 'pra você, pra casa, pra fazer'. It also participates in sequences with articles: 'pro, pros, pras'. The frequency of reduction depends on rhythm, emphasis, region, and communicative situation.
Reducing 'para' does not imply not knowing the standard form. It is a normal phonetic and stylistic process.
